Subject: Owners alignment: bridgework for Q3 OKRs + QBR rehearsal

Team —

Putting this thread together to lock the owner-side decisions for the Q3 OKR slate and the accompanying QBR rehearsal. Goal is to leave today with: a) a short list of owner signoffs (where owners explicitly consent to targets), b) a finalized QBR runbook draft for rehearsals, and c) a contingency plan for any capacity/risk items that would change measurement gates.

Attachments: Q3_OKR_draft_v2.xlsx (owners tab populated), QBR_rehearsal_script_v1.md. Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQBR-playbook

Key asks (please reply inline):
- Confirm acceptance (or provide redlines) for the three revenue-linked objectives by 2pm PT.
- Marcus: confirm whether the current Dedicated capacity forecast supports the throughput target in Obj #2. If not, propose a mitigant.
- Kim: sanity-check the measurement rubric (sheet "metrics") and call out any out-of-band metrics we need in the QBR deck.
- Vanessa/Grace: volunteer for the rehearser panel and confirm availability for a 60m dry run at 4pm PT today.

I will consolidate and then escalate any unresolved items to execs tomorrow morning. Short bullets preferred.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Product Strategy, Redwood Inference

Hannah —

Quick read done. Two small asks from my side:
1) On the measurement rubric, can we add an "evaluation cadence" column (weekly vs. monthly)? Helps the QBR deck explain short-term gates.
2) For Obj #1 (Adoption velocity), recommend the threshold be 8% lower to reflect the shipping lag on the beta feature — happy to accept 0.85x if Marcus confirms throughput.

I can join the 4pm dry run.

Hannah / team —

Checked the Dedicated capacity forecast and the short answer is: under current commit assumptions Obj #2's throughput target oversubscribes evening peak windows by ~12%. Attaching capacity_model_v3.csv with the scenario toggles I ran.

Proposed mitigants (pick one):
- Reduce the target by 10% (operationally clean).
- Shift some non-critical traffic to the cheaper quantized model pool (requires ~48h infra change).
- Implement a temporary routing cap for customers on free tier during ramp weeks (policy + comms).

If the team wants to keep the original throughput target we should include an explicit deployment plan in the QBR runbook and mark the metric as "contingent" (and call this out in the leadership slides).

I can be on the 4pm dry run remotely.

—Marcus
Staff Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

All —

+1 to Kim's cadence column. Marcus, thanks for the capacity scenarios — that clarifies the tradeoffs. From a product/regulatory POV I think we should:
- Add a "risk delta" column to the OKR sheet that calls out whether the metric is dependent on infra changes, partner commitments, or customer opt-in.
- Mark Obj #2 as "conditional" with the mitigant plan you suggested (I prefer the routing cap as the short-term lever).

Nora from Tide AI (cc'd) flagged that a partner feature launch timeline might slip two weeks; that would add pressure to adoption velocity. Nora — can you confirm partner readiness by EOD?

I'll join the 4pm dry run. Grace, can you take notes and own the action tracker?

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Short consolidation and next steps: 

1) Measurement rubric: Kim to add "evaluation cadence" column and Vanessa to add "risk delta" (owner: kimberly_park / vanessa_ortiz).
2) Obj #1 threshold: accept Kim's 0.85x adjustment pending partner confirmation. (Action: Nora to confirm partner readiness by EOD.)
3) Obj #2 throughput: mark as CONDITIONAL in the OKR sheet and include Marcus' routing-cap mitigant in the runbook. Owner: marcus_lin — add mitigant steps to the QBR_rehearsal_script_v1.md by tomorrow 09:00 PT.
4) QBR dry run: 4pm PT today — panel: Vanessa (CS), Kim (GTM), Marcus (Eng). Grace to take notes and maintain action tracker.
5) Exec escalation: if any of the above remain unresolved by 09:00 tomorrow, I'll escalate to the exec brief (cc: CEO, COO).

I've attached the updated sheets with inline comments and added the "conditional" flag to Obj #2. Final sign-off: please reply with a one-line "ACCEPT" if you consent to the consolidated slate. If you have redlines, reply inline.

Hannah
